content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Delivers home medical supplies and equipment billed to insurers; no hospice care or plumbing service overlap."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Commercial fire protection and building safety contracting, not hospice care or residential plumbing service."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Pediatric and adult in-home nursing and therapy; lacks hospice care and plumbing services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Operates senior living communities funded by resident fees; does not provide hospice or plumbing services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Commercial HVAC and mechanical contracting for building projects, not residential plumbing service or hospice."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale distributor of plumbing and HVAC products to contractors, not a service provider to end customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance, mortgage lending and cemetery businesses; no hospice care or plumbing service overlap."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Medical product manufacturer and health software maker, not a provider of hospice or plumbing services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures HVAC and detection equipment for utilities and transit; not hospice or plumbing service."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Operates hospice and home health alongside skilled nursing, funded largely by Medicare and Medicaid, like the target's hospice unit."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Uniform rental and facility supplies for businesses; no hospice care or plumbing service overlap."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Operates acute care and behavioral hospitals; differs from hospice care and plumbing services."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures commercial plumbing fixtures and water products sold through distributors; no service business like the target's."}]}
